log.title: Marsh bought a dog sanctuary
log.text: 200 empty kennels. Every follow is a new dog. Comment your breed on the reel to get yours.

log.title: The first dogs move in
log.text: 833 new dogs moved in, and Marsh Town opened: Marsh Mart, the library, Muscle Mutts gym and the cinema.

log.title: The waterpark opens
log.text: 699 new dogs moved in, and Marsh built a waterpark with slides and a lazy river.
